note: Conforming package index for the custom Harry's/Flamingo-derived packages. Fill the source owner/repo/ref after pushing. brand-product-foundation is the keystone: run it first; every other package reads the brand-product profile it writes. App packages (command-center, creative-component-dashboard, producer-cockpit, coverage-matrix) are rebuild-on-setup: they scaffold a fresh app in the target instance from that brand's own Motion data. Only packages that physically exist under packages/ are listed.

packages.name: Brand & Product Foundation
packages.description: Keystone setup: guided brand + full product catalog + claims + naming + connections + KPI + delivery interview; writes the canonical brand-product profile every other package reads.

packages.name: Creative Performance Reporting
packages.description: Daily performance report + monthly creative strategy digest over the brand's own Meta data. Reads the profile for product breakdown.

packages.name: Creative Command Center
packages.description: Rebuild-on-setup per-product performance app: fatigue, clusters, trajectory, forecast, benchmark, actions.

packages.name: Creative Component Dashboard
packages.description: Rebuild-on-setup app decoding ad names into components and rolling up performance by hook, format, angle, product, creator.

packages.name: Producer Cockpit
packages.description: Rebuild-on-setup producer app: top-ad hook/script teardowns with transcripts, recent work, live competitor/inspo video feed.

packages.name: Coverage & Whitespace Matrix
packages.description: Rebuild-on-setup app: angles x products grid of tested vs whitespace with performance where tested.

packages.name: Competitor Roster
packages.description: Maps the brand's competitors into a tracked roster with a weekly read; seeds from profile competitors and enriches with followed brands (brand chooses at setup).

packages.name: Competitor & Inspo Board
packages.description: Rebuild-on-setup browsable board of competitor + inspo creatives, filterable by brand/format/angle, honoring a video-only preference.

packages.name: DTC Intel Corpus
packages.description: Searchable brain corpus of DTC/competitor intelligence with a recurring digest; sources chosen by the brand at setup. Pairs with corpus-search.
